question: how many fresh page loads of 60 public sites carry a loop that runs while the page is visible or hidden: a frame loop, a timer loop, a request every few seconds, a video that plays with no input, or an infinite CSS animation; the raw per-second counts behind each
instrument: Chromium Chrome/156.0.8078.4 (the build @playwright/test bundles), driven over the Chrome DevTools Protocol with the launch of scripts/measure/cdp-hidden.ts; the page-side counters are installed before the first script and read once a second; the Network domain counts requests started in each window

software.browser: Chrome/156.0.8078.4, bundled with @playwright/test, driven over raw CDP

method.pages: the home page of each site, then the first of the first five internal links that loads (the rule of first-view.ts); the links come from the server HTML of the home page, fetched once with a plain GET
method.context: a fresh browser context per visit: no cookies, no storage, no service worker registered by spool; viewport 1280 by 800; one window at a time, visits in sequence

windows.hidden: a second tab created and activated in the same window (Target.createTarget with newWindow false, Target.activateTarget), the mechanism of cdp-hidden.ts

method.seconds: each second is the interval between two reads of the page; the first read of a window discards the counts before it
method.validity: a window counts when the page reported the expected visibility in at least 18 of its 20 seconds; otherwise the classes that need it are null

classes.visible-frame-loop: rAF callbacks at least 20 a second on at least 15 of the 20 visible seconds
classes.hidden-frame-loop: rAF callbacks at least 1 a second on at least 15 of the 20 hidden seconds
classes.hidden-timer-loop: timer callbacks, registered at 1000 ms or more, at least 1 a second on at least 15 of the 20 hidden seconds; timers under 1000 ms are left out, because a hidden tab clamps them to 1 Hz
classes.poll: at least 3 requests started during the 20 visible seconds, any type, origin or frame
classes.autoplay: a visible second in which a top-document video advanced and was not paused
classes.css-animation: a visible second with a running animation of infinite iterations
classes.any: at least one of the six classes above; null when none holds and one is unmeasured
classes.hidden-timer-any: a separate class: timer callbacks of any delay, at least 1 a second on at least 15 of the 20 hidden seconds; includes the browser clamp

method.retry: a visit that fails, or whose document answers 400 or more, is retried once in a fresh context; a second failure is recorded
method.unit: a share of pages loaded fresh (one visit each), not a share of page views and not weighted by traffic
method.javascript: counts of rAF, timers, fetch, XHR, sendBeacon, WebSocket and EventSource calls are for the top document only; requests cover every frame
method.storage: the site is an origin; a page is its origin and first path segment; no query, fragment, request URL or response body is stored
method.pacing: 250 ms after each visit, one browser

exclusions: a window whose page reported the expected visibility in fewer than 18 of 20 seconds is kept; the derivation leaves the classes that need it out
